question: When is a student placed on academic probation?
answer:
According to [1] (GMU_Academic_Policies.pdf, p.4) and [2] (GMU_Academic_Policies.pdf, p.3), a student is placed on Academic Probation if all of the following conditions are met:

1. The student has previously received an Academic Warning in any previous term.
2. The student receives a term GPA below 2.00.
3. The student has a cumulative GPA below 2.00.

Additionally, [2] (GMU_Academic_Policies.pdf, p.3) states that students who incur Academic Probation can register for a limited number of credits (see AP.5.2.7 Academic Performance and Credit Level).
